newsitem.title: CHAD: Chad to raise cotton producer price in 1996/97.
newsitem.headline: Chad to raise cotton producer price in 1996/97.

text.p: Chad is to raise its official farmgate price for top grade seed cotton to 170 CFA per kg in 1996/97 from 140 CFA last season, majority state-owned cotton firm Cotontchad said in a statement.
Second grade cotton would be bought for 120 CFA, up 20 CFA on last season's price, it added.
Third grade cotton remains unchanged at 60 CFA per kg.
Cotton output is officially estimated at 205,000 tonnes for the 1996/97 season against around 156,000 tonnes in 1995/96.
Exports of cotton fibre are forecast to stay around the same level at 60,000 tonnes.
Tchad exports to Portugal, Germany, Greece, Italy, France and Japan. China has also put in a demand to buy cotton this season (1996/97), Cotontchad said.
According to the company, Chad is the fifth largest cotton producer in Africa. ($1=514 CFA Francs) Abidjan newsroom +225 21 90 90
